title: Polite Distance
summary: River needs a nice, boring driver to lose an unmarked sedan that has followed him for two days, then wait for the driver to show.
description: An unmarked sedan has followed River for two days. He needs a boring driver to lose it with him, with no shooting, and he called V because V is easy to ask.

start.bringUp: An unmarked sedan has followed River for two days. He wants a boring driver to lose it with him, and he does not want a shooting. Bring it up as a favour.

carpark.name: the car park by the Heywood stairwell

RW4.open.01.text: V. It's River. Don't turn around if you're outside.

RW4.open.02.text: Unmarked sedan, two days now. Dark. Too clean to be a cop.

RW4.open.03.text: I don't want a shooting. I want to know who's in it.

RW4.open.04.text: You drive, I read the mirror. Can you be a very boring driver?

RW4.open.05.text: Watson. I'll send the pin. Don't speed.

RW4.open.06.text: And V. Thanks. For being easy to ask.

RW4.s2.01.text: Left side, two cars back. He's too clean to be a cop.

RW4.s2.02.text: Never run. Never turn quickly. Make them think you're lost.

RW4.s2.03.text: Good. Normal. Boring. You're a natural.

RW4.s2.04.text: He's still there. He's good. Not that good.

RW4.s2.05.text: He's closing. Slow down. Let him sit on you.

RW4.s2.06.text: Tunnel. Brake lights only. Nothing flashy.

RW4.s2.07.text: He's gone. Don't celebrate. Turn right.

RW4.s2.08.text: Cops. The one thing worse than him. Ease off.

RW4.s3.01.text: Park here. I'll wait by the door. You stay in the car.

RW4.s3.02.text: While we wait. Do you ever feel followed when nobody is?

RW4.s3.03.text: Evening. Long drive. Want to tell me who sent you?

RW4.s4.01.text: He gave a name I know. I don't like it.

RW4.s4.02.text: Jamie Sheen taught me. Let a man think he's winning.

RW4.bark.lost.b.text: That's a good turn. He won't read it.

RW4.close.01.text: Lost a tail and cornered a man. No shots. A good day.

RW4.close.03.text: Lost him, not found him. A week of mirrors.

RW4.close.04.text: The police noticed before he did. That's a joke. I'm laughing.

RW4.close.05.text: He drew. We handled it. Don't tell Joss.

g1.asks: Can you be a very boring driver?
g1.know: You know the plan and the route, and that police heat ruins it. You suspect who is in the sedan.

g2.asks: Do you ever feel followed when nobody is?
g2.know: You know V's life and what V has said about threats.
g2.secret: You have felt followed since the badge.

stages.label: River calls for a boring driver
stages.objective: Meet River at the Watson meeting place
stages.know: You are in the Watson meeting place, or heading there, with an unmarked sedan on your tail for two days. You called V because V is easy to ask.
stages.wants: V to come to the Watson meeting place and drive.

stages.label: V drives River through Watson with a tail
stages.objective: Drive River through Watson with the sedan on your tail
stages.know: A dark sedan is following V's car at a distance of about 60 metres. The route runs through Japantown, Charter Hill, a tunnel and the Heywood underpass, and police heat ruins the plan.
stages.wants: V to lose the sedan by distance and keep the heat down.

stages.label: River waits for the driver in the car park
stages.objective: Wait with River in the Heywood car park
stages.know: V is parked in the Heywood car park. River is waiting by the stairwell door, and the sedan's driver is coming to the car park.
stages.wants: V to stay in the car within 20 metres and let River talk to the driver.

stages.label: River hears who sent the driver
stages.objective: Hear River's reaction to who sent the driver at the Heywood car park
stages.know: The driver has talked. He gave a name you know, and River does not like it.
stages.wants: V to hear the name and decide what to do with it.

named.memory: You and River lost a tail in Watson and cornered the man behind it with a single sentence.

lost-only.memory: You and River lost the tail in Watson, but the man behind it was never found, and River kept checking his mirrors for a week.

hot.memory: The police noticed the tail before it noticed you, and River laughed at the irony.

fight.memory: The driver drew in the car park, and you and River handled it.

no-ride.memory: You did not come to Watson, and River drove back into the city alone.
